queuename.title: Queue JNDI Name
queuename.remarks: JNDI name of the JMS queue.

providerpassword.title: Provider Password
providerpassword.remarks: Provider password used for creating jms connection

inconfactory.title: Initial Context Factory
inconfactory.remarks: Identifies the class that connects to the JMS server. This is specific to the application server.

userid.title: User ID
userid.remarks: User ID for accessing the corresponding JMS queue.

providerurl.title: Provider URL
providerurl.remarks: URL for accessing the JMS server.

password.title: Password
password.remarks: Password for accessing a password-protected queue.

tenantcode.title: Tenant
tenantcode.remarks: The unique identifier for the tenant. All users that belong to this tenant enter this code as part of their login credentials. The identifier is used as the USERID value and the PERSONID value for this tenant.If you enter a long identifier when you create a tenant, the identifier is shortened. You can modify the value, but after you save it, the identifier is  read only.

maxtrycount.title: Maximum Try Count
maxtrycount.remarks: Number of times the MEA tries to process a message before writing the message to the error log and sending an email notification to the system administrator. Value cannot be less than 0.

emailaddr.title: E-mail Address
emailaddr.remarks: Address to which the MEA sends notification of transaction errors in the queue. This is typically the e-mail address of a system administrator If no value is specified, the MEA sends error notification to the Administrator Email Address specified in the Integration Administration Setup dialog box.

qconfactjndiname.title: Queue Connection Factory
qconfactjndiname.remarks: Identifies the connection factory for accessing the queue. Default is jms/mro/int/queues/sqin.

provideruser.title: Provider User
provideruser.remarks: Provider user used for creating jms connection

iscompress.title: Compress
iscompress.remarks: add column to indicate compression requirements

isinbound.title: Inbound
isinbound.remarks: Specifies whether the corresponding queue is an inbound or an outbound queue. If the check box is selected, it is an inbound queue.

issequential.title: Sequential
issequential.remarks: Specifies whether the inbound queue is a continuous or sequential queue. Both types process inbound messages on a first in first out basis, but the sequential queue stops processing messages in the queue if it encounters an error, while the continuous queue processes subsequent messages in the queue after it encounters an error. If the checkbox is selected, the queue is sequential.

userdefined.title: User Defined
userdefined.remarks: Specifies whether the queue was predefined (MEA-supplied) or created by a user. If the check box is selected, a user created the queue.
